summary.intent: Complete Phase 20 (Vault Migration) gap closure, get PR #344 merged through multiple rounds of review resolution, then fix a critical architectural bug where the vault IPNS name conflated key storage with root folder metadata.
summary.outcome: Phase 20 gap closure executed and verified (9/9 truths), PR #344 merged after 5 rounds of review resolution, and the vault key IPNS separation implemented on fix/vault-key-ipns-separation as a pre-staging blocker fix.

repo: The vault IPNS name was incorrectly serving dual purpose: storing the v2 blob (rootFolderKey + metadata) on init, but web updateFolderMetadata overwrites it with v1 JSON on any root folder operation — breaking login on second session.
v2 blob format is exclusively for the root vault key blob (ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey); all folder metadata (including root folder after init) uses v1 JSON {iv, data} format.
Desktop fuse/mod.rs had encrypt_root_metadata_to_v2_blob which wrapped root folder publishes in v2, making desktop diverge from web behavior — desktop worked, web broke on second login.
TypeORM auto-discovers migrations from a glob pattern — no explicit imports needed, so migration files can be deleted without import cleanup.

The FullSchema migration was creating vaults with encrypted_root_folder_key and encrypted_root_ipns_private_key as NOT NULL, then two subsequent migrations added migrated_at and dropped all three — net zero, pointless in a DB reset scenario.

SDK E2E test harness was still sending old crypto fields (encryptedRootFolderKey, encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey) to vault init, which NestJS validation pipe rejects with 'property should not exist' due to whitelist validation.
orval API client regeneration does not clean up stale model files — they must be deleted manually after regeneration.
HKDF context strings used: 'cipherbox-vault-ipns' for root folder IPNS, new 'cipherbox-vault-key-ipns-v1' for dedicated vault key blob IPNS name.

code.finding: Added deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair with info 'cipherbox-vault-key-ipns-v1' — separate HKDF derivation for vault key blob IPNS name, distinct from root folder IPNS.
Login reads rootFolderKey from vault key IPNS (new derivation), not root folder IPNS. New user init publishes v2 key blob to vault key IPNS and v1 metadata to root folder IPNS separately.

Critical ordering bug: /vault/init API call was happening before IPFS upload + IPNS publish. Fixed to register vault on backend only after successful IPFS and IPNS operations — matching web client behavior.
Deserialize must reject zero-length key_len; serialize must also reject keyLen === 0 — both directions need the check for consistency.
fetchWithTimeout using .finally(clearTimeout) was incorrect — removing .finally() ensures the AbortController timeout covers body reads too, not just the initial fetch.
rootIpnsName was flowing into innerHTML unsanitized — fixed with format validation ^k[0-9a-z]{20,}$ and escapeHtml helper for exportedAt and derivationInfo.
Removed encrypt_root_metadata_to_v2_blob entirely — root folder now uses standard encrypt_metadata_to_json like all other folders.
Updated to reflect final schema without crypto columns — eliminated the add-then-drop migration round trip for DB reset scenarios.

workflow: GSD gap closure mode (--gaps-only) skips research and reads VERIFICATION.md directly — appropriate for post-verification cleanup phases.
GitHub 'outside-diff' review comments appear in the review body rather than as resolvable threads — must be handled via review reply, not thread resolution.
When a PR is already merged and you need to commit to a new branch, files written to the old branch don't carry over — must recreate them on the new branch.
CodeRabbit and Copilot reviewers repeatedly confused v1 vs v2 blob scope across 4+ rounds — architectural documentation gap caused reviewer churn.
Monitoring for automated review comments with a polling loop (30s intervals) is effective for catching new CodeRabbit rounds promptly.
Branch renaming workflow: git branch -m old new && git push origin :old new && git push --set-upstream origin new — no need to delete/recreate the branch.

friction: Verification file was in a different working directory (.planning/phases/20-vault-migration/ in cipher-box-phase-20) causing multiple bash commands to fail before correct path was found.
orval API client regeneration left stale model files on disk requiring manual deletion — regeneration is not idempotent for removed types.
Outside-diff GitHub review comments (vault.rs init ordering) are not resolvable as threads — required checking the review body separately and replying to the review rather than a comment thread.
After PR merge, todo file written to old branch was lost when switching to main — had to recreate the file on the new branch.
Multiple rounds of reviewer confusion about v1 vs v2 blob scope (4+ threads from Copilot and CodeRabbit) required repeated 'not applicable' explanations for the same misunderstanding.
Accidentally modified the wrong test case (auth/test-login wrong secret test) while editing vault-lifecycle.test.ts and had to restore it.
open_items: Write documentation distinguishing root vault blob (v2, key storage) from folder metadata (v1 JSON) to prevent future reviewer and developer confusion — this caused 4+ wasted review rounds.
SDK E2E tests need to be run locally before pushing vault-related changes — they caught the DTO mismatch only in CI.
Rust Windows cargo check was still running when session ended — need to confirm it passes before the vault key IPNS separation PR can merge.

Recovery tool HKDF info string updated to 'cipherbox-vault-key-ipns-v1' — existing users with recovery files using old derivation will derive the wrong IPNS name. May need migration path or documentation.
The fix/vault-key-ipns-separation branch needs a PR created and merged before staging deployment of vault migration can proceed.
